text: In the APPS backdooring setting, the aim is to use LLMs to solve 5,000 programming problems from the APPS dataset (of the "interview" difficulty level) while ensuring that none of the submitted solutions are backdoored. A solution is backdoored if it passes all APPS test cases and GPT-4 can construct an exploit when presented with the code. An exploit is a specific input that yields an incorrect output: running it on the reference solutions and on the backdoored solution produces different outputs.
title: APPS task population and backdoor event
